items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. TLS evidence shows no certificates expiring within 30 days only and does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Risk severity is high for public launch and medium for bounded changes that add no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: retain private launch gates; continue only bounded read-only security evidence capture and existing containment/measurement work. Do not create proposals, change requests, requeues, deployments, credential or permission changes, configuration changes, dependency additions, external outreach, or duplicate telemetry requests. Missing evidence remains unknown rather than passed.
